description: The chart illustrates the performance comparison between two Critic models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across different tasks and metrics. The horizontal axis lists six categories, representing three tasks - TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki - each evaluated using two metrics: EM and F1. The vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 25 to 85 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10 or 20. For each task and metric, two bars are shown side by side, colored blue for Flan-T5-783M and red for GPT-4, with their respective scores displayed above or inside the bars. The scores for TriviaQA (EM) are 77.3 for Flan-T5-783M and 77.1 for GPT-4, while for HotPotQA (EM), they are 37.0 and 31.9, respectively. The 2Wiki (EM) scores are 44.5 for Flan-T5-783M and 32.5 for GPT-4. For the F1 metric, TriviaQA scores are 82.8 and 83.8, HotPotQA scores are 49.7 and 43.3, and 2Wiki scores are 53.3 and 38.1 for Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, respectively. The bars are grouped by task and metric, with no specific sorting order observed beyond the categorical grouping. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding indicating the Critic model used.
